source.notes: Exact Spathiphyllum wallisii not in MiFloraDB; using representative entry "spathiphyllum 'figaro'" with typical peace-lily care ranges.

care.soil: Peat covered with a layer of sphagnum moss on soil surface to keep moisture
care.sunlight: Like half shade, should put in places with bright scattered light
care.watering: Likes wet environments, water thoroughly when soil is dry, may spray water in the air or on leaves, reduce water in winter, keep soil moist
care.fertilization: Dilute fertilizers following instructions, apply liquid fertilizers 1-2 times monthly
care.pruning: Remove rotten roots, old diseased and dead leaves timely
care.blooming: Flowers year around with spathe flower, viewing period 2-3 months

solutions.advice: Water thoroughly until water drains, then empty the saucer. Avoid letting the root ball stay bone-dry for long.
Hold off watering and improve drainage. Soggy soil risks root rot; check that the pot drains freely.
Move the plant away from cold drafts and windows. Keep within its preferred temperature range.
Reduce heat stress: move out of hot direct sun or away from heaters; increase airflow.
Raise humidity with a tray of pebbles and water, grouping plants, or a humidifier. Avoid soaking fuzzy leaves if applicable.
Increase airflow and avoid misting. Persistent high humidity can encourage fungal spots.
Follow species watering guidance: Likes wet environments, water thoroughly when soil is dry, may spray water in the air or on leaves, reduce water in winter, keep soil moist

common_problems: too much direct sun / leaf scorch
